rationale: The geometry provides a balanced sensor array well centered and spaced to cover the tape line width, which supports effective line position sensing. The controller uses a moderate base speed (1.5) to balance speed and control, with proportional gain (kp=10) strong enough to respond to line deviations, integral gain (ki=0.5) to correct steady-state errors, and derivative gain (kd=1.5) to damp oscillations. Sensor weights are symmetric and increase from right to left sensors, producing a steering signal that guides the robot smoothly along the line. The line loss strategy is 'search_left' to steer left when the line is lost, which is a reasonable default. The observation request includes completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to evaluate performance and guide future tuning.
